record: HABS FL-138 written survey, exterior description and restoration record
facts: The principal house is about 56 by 32 feet including connected portions. The south front has five bays. Plastered coquina walls support a partly wood-framed upper storey. A cedar-shingle roof retains the original west hip. The east balcony and rear loggia are distinct. Most sash are six-over-six.

record: City of St. Augustine coquina building field survey, p. 25
facts: Municipal survey identifies the house at 14 Saint Francis Street, restored in 1960, with stucco, wood siding and coquina. The facing wall has gate openings and low first-storey sills.
